cases.title: What does a "first EMI date" fix touch outside its diff?
cases.summary: Asked about the three commits in the maintainers' merged fix, Meeba Brain explained each one from its own diff, traced the call chain in `loan_repayment_schedule.py` with line links, and found a test gap: no test covers an early payment made before an interest-only first EMI. The run took 72.5 seconds.
cases.miss: it missed that the new first EMI date also changes the interest charged for the deferred period, and earlier runs invented commit messages for commits they had not read. The case study shows both next to the real code.
cases.note: Independent analysis. Not an endorsement by Frappe. The fix was written and merged by the frappe/lending maintainers.
cases.readme_title: frappe/lending: early payment and the first EMI date
cases.question: What do the three commits in the merged fix [#1537](https://github.com/frappe/lending/pull/1537) change, and what outside the diff can they affect?
cases.check: Outside the diff: the effect on interest for the deferred period (which the answer missed) and a test gap for interest-only first EMIs; then the call chain and line references

cases.title: What does the fix for a misleading annotation error really change?
cases.summary: Asked about the proposed fix, Meeba Brain traced the behaviour changes in `custom_tool.py`, linked them to the new regression tests, and flagged a possible compatibility risk from changing a private function's return value. It read 7 files in about five and a half minutes.
cases.miss: it gave one test the wrong name, and its compatibility risk still had to be checked against the function's callers by hand. The case study shows both next to the real code.
cases.note: Independent analysis. Not an endorsement by Composio. The maintainers later fixed the issue in #5061; pull request #5024 was not merged.
cases.readme_title: Composio Python SDK: unresolved annotation error
cases.question: What does the proposed fix for issue [#5022](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/issues/5022) ([PR #5024](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/pull/5024)) really change? (The issue was later fixed by the maintainers in [#5061](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio/pull/5061).)
cases.check: Outside the diff: one caller of the changed private function; then the behaviour changes, the tests that cover them, and one test the answer named wrongly

quotes.text: Meeba Brain is a useful debugging tool, and it handles large open-source repos well.
quotes.name: Aakash Bhardwaj

quotes.text: I tested it on a real PDF parsing bug. It understood the underlying error context and gave a more accurate fix than the AI tools I normally reach for.
quotes.name: Akshat Tamrakar
